segments.text: Roadworks ahead. One lane. Someone with a sign tells you when to go.
But today, that someone is a parrot. What do you do?
Most drivers get impatient, and honk at the parrot.
Big mistake. Parrots copy everything. Honk! Honk! And then, the whole family flies in. Honking.
They think your shiny car is a giant egg. So they carry it up, into their nest, on top of the crane. Now you have to sit on it. For three weeks.
Here's how you do it properly.
Don't honk. Wind down the window, and offer him a cracker.
Now he's your best friend. So teach him one tiny word: please.
He spins his sign to GO. And the giant digger on the other side? It gets a very stern STOP.
Drive through slowly. He even waves you off with his wing.
Next exam question: the lorry behind you is full of watermelons. Follow, so you don't miss it.
